chinese: 每年一到国考省考各种考就特别心烦，发自内心不想考。完全不想看书就跟本不走心，根本不走心就不看书，不看书考试就打酱油，打酱油就吊脖子分数，吊脖子分数就挨骂，挨骂就生气，生气就更加不想考！死循环！资！
translation_A: Every year, whenever there are national and provincial exams, I get super annoyed. Deep down, I really don't want to take them. If I completely don't care and don't study, then I won't study at all. Not studying means I'll just be there for show, just for show means I'll get a low score, getting a low score means I'll get scolded, getting scolded makes me even more angry, and being angry makes me even less inclined to take exams! It's a vicious cycle! F*cking annoying!
translation_B: Every year, as soon as national and provincial exams start, I get really annoyed. Deep down, I just don't want to take them. I completely don't feel like reading because I'm not into it, so if I'm not into it, I won't read. If I don't read, I'll just be going through the motions for the exam, going through the motions will get me low scores, low scores will lead to criticism, criticism will make me even more angry, and being angry makes me even less inclined to take exams! It's a vicious cycle! F*ck!
translation_C: Every year when national and provincial exams start, I get really annoyed. Deep down, I don't want to take them at all. If I completely don't care and don't study, then I won't study. Not studying means I'll just be there for the sake of it, just there for the sake of it means I'll get low scores, getting low scores means I'll get scolded, getting scolded makes me even more angry, and being angry makes me even less inclined to take them! It's a vicious cycle! F*cking hell!

chinese: 小包子终于拉出臭臭啦！四天没拉了！那酸爽……每次包子拉很多臭臭的时候如果是爸爸换尿布他必定大声喊：宝宝拉臭臭啦，哎呦好多好多，妈妈快来，要给宝宝洗屁屁。要是妈妈换尿布，就淡定擦好换好……刚刚出门前婆婆特意起来叮嘱，你晚上不要吃辣的，宝宝会上火不就前天吃了剁椒鱼头嘛！
translation_A: The little bun finally pooped! Four days without! That sour-sweet feeling... Every time the bun poops a lot, if Dad changes the diaper, he always shouts loudly: Baby pooped, oh my, so much, mom, come quickly, need to clean the bottom for the baby. If Mom changes the diaper, she just calmly wipes and changes... Just before we left, grandma specially got up to remind me, don't eat spicy food at night, the baby will get heaty, right? Didn't they have spicy fish head the other day?
translation_B: The little bun finally pooped! Four days without a bowel movement! That's so refreshing... Every time the bun poops a lot, if Dad changes the diaper, he always shouts loudly: "Baby is pooping, oh my, so much, mom, come quickly, need to clean the baby's bottom." If Mom changes it, she just calmly wipes and changes... Just now, before we left, grandma specially got up to remind me not to eat spicy food at night, or the baby will get heaty—didn't the baby have spicy fish head stew two days ago?
translation_C: The little bun finally pooped! Four days without! That acid爽... Every time the bun poops a lot, if Dad changes the diaper, he always shouts loudly: Baby pooped, oh my, so much, mom, come quickly, need to clean the bottom for the baby. If Mom changes the diaper, she just calmly wipes and changes... Just before we left, grandma specially got up to remind me not to eat spicy food at night, or the baby will get heaty, right? Didn't the baby get heaty the day before from eating chili-headed fish head?

chinese: 昨晚上被一只蚊子吵醒N次（没错我就是连蚊子嗡嗡都能醒的体质），最后忍无可忍4点多爬起来打蚊子，手机光一照才发现，蚊子根本就在帐子外面！它咬不到我只是要在我耳边骚扰而已！气死我了，当下把它捏了个粉碎
translation_A: Last night, a mosquito woke me up multiple times (I really am that sensitive, even to the hum of a mosquito), and finally around 4 AM I got out of bed to swat it. But when I shone my phone light, I realized the mosquito was actually outside the mosquito net! It didn't bite me; it just wanted to bug me by my ear! I was so frustrated, I squished it right there.
translation_B: Last night, a mosquito woke me up multiple times (I swear I'm that sensitive, even the buzzing of a mosquito can wake me), finally at around 4 AM I got so frustrated that I got out of bed to swat it, only to realize with my phone light that the mosquito was actually outside the mosquito net! It couldn't bite me but just wanted to harass me by my ear! I was so pissed off that I squished it right there.
translation_C: Last night, a mosquito woke me up multiple times (I really am that sensitive to even the hum of a mosquito), and finally around 4 AM I got out of bed to swat it. But when I shone my phone light, I realized the mosquito was actually outside the mosquito net! It didn't bite me; it just wanted to harass me by my ear! I was so frustrated, I squished it right there!

chinese: 成大事者，必先看好牙齿。否则吃嘛嘛不香，影响心情怎么做事？我的漫漫看牙路。。
translation_A: Big achievers must first take good care of their teeth. Otherwise, you won't enjoy your food, and that affects your mood—how can you do anything? My long journey to dental enlightenment...
translation_B: One who wants to achieve great things must first take good care of their teeth. Otherwise, if eating doesn't taste good, how can you focus on anything? My long journey to dental care...
translation_C: One who wants to achieve great things must first take good care of their teeth. Otherwise, if eating isn't enjoyable, how can you be in the right frame of mind to do anything? My long journey towards dental enlightenment...

chinese: 坐公交车大爷大妈着急下车，两人挤着我的头发就往门口跑，差点把我脑袋拽下去，妈呀呀，这长头发是我的啊，你们干嘛拽着不放呢
translation_A: Sitting on the bus, an elderly couple was in a hurry to get off. They grabbed my hair and tried to squeeze past me towards the door, nearly pulling my head down with them. Oh my god, this long hair is mine! Why won't you let go?
translation_B: Sitting on the bus, an elderly couple was in a hurry to get off. They grabbed my hair and tried to squeeze past me towards the door, nearly pulling my head down with them. Oh my god, this long hair is mine! Why won't you let go?
translation_C: Grandpas and grandmas on the bus were in a hurry to get off, and the two of them pulled my hair as they rushed towards the door, almost pulling my head down with it, oh my god, this long hair is mine, why won't you let go of it?
